item.name: Solana Swap Review
item.description: Jupiter order preparation and signed-payload execution boundary. Postman never creates the wallet signature. SECURITY BOUNDARY: Copy the unsigned transaction to the connected wallet, sign outside Postman, then provide only the signed serialized payload to the execute request.
